data.name: EntryDateHint
data.value: Determines which accounting period the entry falls in. Cannot be created if that period is closed or closing.

data.name: ManualJournalNotice
data.value: Manual journals are entered in the base currency. Only accounts flagged as manually selectable are listed — inventory, GR/IR accrual and the like are maintained by automatic postings and a hand-entered line there will not reconcile with the subledger.

data.name: PasteHint
data.value: One entry per line: account code, debit, credit, line description, separated by tab or comma (use tab if the amounts carry thousand separators). The account must be flagged as manually selectable or the line is skipped. This is how opening balances are entered in one go.

data.name: PasteNotManualFmt
data.value: Skipped, not enabled for manual entry: {0} (tick "Allow manual entry" under Chart of Accounts).

data.name: PasteNoCodeFmt
data.value: Skipped {0} line(s) with no account code.

data.name: ManualAccountNote
data.value: Account selection and pasting only accept accounts flagged "Allow manual entry" in the Chart of Accounts. Accounts posted automatically by documents (receivables, payables, inventory, etc.) are deliberately closed to manual entry, otherwise the general ledger would no longer agree with the subledgers; adjust them through the corresponding document, or ask accounting to enable the account in the Chart of Accounts.
